title: 第315章 逐个击破第314章 大秦玉玺
content_zh:
“逐个击破？”
胡娇娇狐疑地看了一眼那些密密麻麻的兵佣，“你说得轻巧，这些玩意儿一看就是同气连枝。你动一个，剩下的怕不是一拥而上？”
徐长生摇了摇头，“你想想刚刚那些石兽。”
“那些石兽，是不是一拥而上的？”
“不是，只有在我们距离它们一定范围，它们才被唤醒的。”慕容月眸光微动。
“没错。所以，只要控制好时间差，把它们逐一引出来，我们就有胜算。”
“走，先退出去。”
众人退出青铜门外。
徐长生从储物袋中取出一枚阵旗，随手一抛，旗尖没入石道口外的岩壁中，旗面微微鼓动，散发出柔和的光芒。
胡娇娇立刻明白了他的意思，“你打算在外面设个陷阱，把兵佣挨个引出去，然后关门打狗？”
“差不多。”
徐长生又取出几枚阵旗，分别布置在石道入口两侧的地面上，组成了一座简单的困阵。
他虽然不擅长布阵，但这些年行走各地，也收集了不少现成阵盘与阵旗，此刻只需激活便是。
“谁去引？”月清瑶目光在众人脸上扫了一圈，最终落在徐念身上，“徐念有穿梭天赋，就算被围住也能脱身，他去最合适。”
徐念拍了拍胸脯，咧嘴一笑：“交给我吧！”
他身形一晃，如同一道轻烟掠入宫殿之中，悄无声息地落在最近的一尊兵佣前方。
那兵佣身高八尺，披甲持戈，面容沉肃，双目虽然由黑曜石雕成，却透着一股不怒自威的杀气。
当徐念距离它三十丈距离时。
“嗡”
一声极细微的嗡鸣从兵佣体内传出，兵佣原本垂落的头猛然抬起，两团暗金色的火焰在眼眶中跳动，锁定了面前这个小小的身影。

紧接着，它手中长戈猛地一转，朝着徐念当头劈落！
徐念只觉得一股凌厉的杀气扑面而来，他甚至来不及多想，那柄长戈已经带着尖锐的破空声拦腰扫来！
"我靠！"
徐念怪叫一声，身体向后一仰，那道戈刃贴着他鼻尖掠过。
戈刃带起的劲风刮得他脸颊生疼，将身后三丈外的石板斩出一道浅浅的裂痕。
这要是慢上半息，被斩断的就是他的腰。
徐念来不及后怕，双脚在地上一蹬，整个人如同一只受惊的兔子般向后弹射而出。
那尊兵佣一击落空，大步迈出，沉重的脚步踏在石板上发出“咚咚”的闷响，紧随其后追了出去。
在它身边的那些兵佣，也逐一被惊醒，一个接一个的大步跟上。
它一出青铜门，便被徐长生早已布置好的困阵笼罩。
阵旗骤然亮起，四道灵光如同锁链般从地面升起，缠绕住兵佣的四肢，将它牢牢钉在石道中央。
兵佣猛地挣扎，暗金色的符文从它铠甲表面浮现，发出一阵刺耳的嗡鸣，试图挣脱束缚。
“我来！”
胡娇娇一步踏出，五指并拢如刀，带着化神境全力一击，刺向兵佣的右眼。
那兵佣虽然四肢被锁，却并未完全失去反抗能力。
它猛地偏头，避开那致命一击的同时，口中发出一声低沉的机关运转之声，仿佛某种机制被触发了。
它左臂的肘部忽然向外弹出一截锋利的铁刃，朝着胡娇娇的腰腹横斩而来！
"还带变形的？"
胡娇娇瞳孔一缩，但她的反应更快，腰肢如同没有骨头一般，向后弯折出一个惊人的弧度，那铁刃贴着她的腹部掠过，将她衣袍下摆划出一道口子。
"找死！"

胡娇娇怒极，身形在弯折的同时猛地一拧，整个人如同陀螺般旋转半圈，右掌顺势从下方斜刺而上，贯穿了兵佣的眼睛。
“咔嚓”
黑曜石眼珠应声碎裂，兵佣挣扎的动作骤然一顿。
但紧接着，是更疯狂的反扑。
content_en:
"Destroy them one by one?"
Hu Jiaojiao glanced at the densely packed military mercenaries suspiciously, "You put it lightly, these things are all in the same spirit at first glance. If you move one, the rest will swarm over you?"
Xu Changsheng shook his head, "Think about those stone beasts just now."
"Did those stone beasts swarm us?"
"No, they are only awakened when we are within a certain distance from them." Murong Yue's eyes moved slightly.
"That's right. So, as long as we control the time difference and draw them out one by one, we have a chance of winning."
"Let's go, exit first."
Everyone exited the bronze door.
Xu Changsheng took out an formation flag from his storage bag and tossed it casually. The tip of the flag sank into the rock wall outside the stone entrance. The flag surface fluttered slightly and emitted a soft light.
Hu Jiaojiao immediately understood what he meant, "Are you going to set a trap outside, lure the mercenaries out one by one, and then close the door and beat the dogs?"
"Almost."
Xu Changsheng took out a few more formation flags and placed them on the ground on both sides of the entrance to the stone path, forming a simple trapping formation.
Although he is not good at setting up formations, he has traveled around the world over the years and has collected a lot of ready-made formation disks and formation flags. All he needs to do now is activate them.
"Who is going to lure them?" Yue Qingyao glanced around everyone's faces, and finally landed on Xu Nian, "Xu Nian has a talent for traveling and can escape even if he is surrounded. It is most suitable for him to go."
Xu Nian patted his chest and grinned: "Leave it to me!"
His body swayed, and like a wisp of smoke swept into the palace, he landed silently in front of the nearest soldier.
The soldier was eight feet tall, wore armor and carried a sword, with a serious face. Although his eyes were made of obsidian, they exuded a murderous aura that was not angry but powerful.
When Xu Nian was thirty feet away from it.
"Buzz"
A very subtle hum came from the mercenary's body. The mercenary's originally drooped head suddenly raised, and two dark golden flames danced in the eye sockets, locking onto the small figure in front of him.
Immediately afterwards, the Changge in its hand suddenly turned and struck Xu Nian head-on!
Xu Nian only felt a sharp murderous aura coming towards him. He didn't even have time to think about it. The long sword had already swept towards his waist with a sharp sound of breaking through the air!
"Holy shit!"
Xu Nian let out a strange cry, leaned back, and the sword blade passed by the tip of his nose.
The strong wind brought by Ge Ren hurt his cheek, and cut a shallow crack into the stone slab three feet away behind him.
If he had been slower than half a breath, his waist would have been severed.
Xu Nian didn't have time to be afraid, he kicked his feet on the ground, and his whole body was ejected backwards like a frightened rabbit.
The soldier mercenary missed the target with one blow and strode forward. His heavy footsteps made a muffled "dong-dong" sound on the stone slab, and he chased after him.
The soldiers and mercenaries around it were also awakened one by one, and strode to follow one after another.
As soon as it exited the bronze door, it was enveloped by the trap that Xu Changsheng had already arranged.
The formation flag suddenly lit up, and four spiritual lights rose from the ground like chains, wrapping around the mercenary's limbs and nailing them firmly to the center of the stone path.
The mercenary struggled violently, and dark golden runes emerged from the surface of its armor, making a harsh buzz as it tried to break free.
"I'll do it!"
Hu Jiaojiao took one step forward, put her five fingers together like a knife, and struck with all her strength from the spirit transformation realm, stabbing the soldier's right eye.
Although the soldier's limbs were chained, he did not completely lose his ability to resist.
It tilted its head sharply to avoid the fatal blow, and at the same time made a low sound of machine operation, as if some mechanism had been triggered.
The elbow of its left arm suddenly shot out a sharp iron blade, slashing towards Hu Jiaojiao's waist and abdomen!
"And a deformed one?"
Hu Jiaojiao's pupils shrank, but her reaction was faster. Her waist seemed to have no bones, bending backwards in an astonishing arc. The iron blade passed against her abdomen and made a gash in the hem of her robe."Seeking death!"
Hu Jiaojiao was so angry that she twisted her body while bending. She spun half a circle like a top, and her right palm thrust diagonally upward from below, piercing the soldier's eyes.
"Click"
The obsidian eyes shattered, and the mercenary's struggling movements suddenly stopped.
But what followed was an even crazier counterattack.
